text: Senna Breeschoten This is the carrier we used to fly our cats. You don't need to get any approval by the airline, just make sure to buy something listed as "IATA carrier", which you can find online. Btw, whether a cat can fly with you in the cabin is not just a matter of weight and you should never take it for granted. Even if it meets the weight restriction, if any passenger complains that they have cat allergy or if the staff decide that they have reached the quota of pets allowed in the cabin, your cat will fly in the cargo anyway...
